milestones.title: The owner's decision on selecting SA-400(1) to SA-400(9), and their statements if selected (48.4-04, 48.4-15)
Your organization's SA-400(1) and SA-400(2) assessments are recorded with the G117 assessment

remediation: The Medium profile selects SA-400 without its nine enhancements, which are the clearest Canadian statement of what sovereign means, and the sovereignty card uses them as its criteria. The owner decides whether the hosted levels select them as organization-defined additions (48.4-04); if they do, 48.4-15 adds their statements and evidence rules from the same facts the card reads, and SA-400(1) and SA-400(2) stay your organization's assessments. Sovereignty: assessments.
